jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are looking for an Inspector (Jet Engines) to join and strengthen our teams.Your RoleAs an Aircraft Engine Inspector, you play a key role in ensuring quality, safety and airworthiness. Your work directly impacts aircraft performance and passenger safety.Your responsibilities include:

• Performing visual and dimensional inspections on dismantled engine parts following approved procedures
• Evaluating parts, modules or engines (serviceable, repairable or scrap) and recording decisions in the ERP system
• Launching and following up required actions based on inspection findings
• Using the appropriate tools, materials and inspection methods
• Ensuring full traceability by correctly closing inspection tasks
• Defining the future configuration of parts and modules
• Carrying out incoming inspections after repair or purchase
• Performing final inspections after internal repairs

Your profile

We are looking fo inspectors who take pride in being quality-driven, technically strong and comfortable taking responsibility.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Demonstrated experience as an Inspector with solid knowledge of aircraft engines
• A strong focus on quality, safety and compliance
• The ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure
• Flexibility and adaptability in changing working conditions
• A proactive mindset and sound decision‑making skills
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two‑shift system (06:00-14:00 / 14:00-22:00)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team
 

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.occupation: ICT Talents - ERP Consultant (Oracle Fusion Cloud)
jobs.description:
For an international trading and distribution organisation, we are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Consultant to technically optimise the existing ERP environment and improve the efficiency of Finance and Operations.

Since the migration to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, many processes are still handled manually, with a lack of reporting and visibility. Your mission? To implement concrete improvements, reduce repetitive tasks and provide the business with the insights and tools it needs.
Job description

As an ERP Consultant, you will work closely with the heads of Finance and Operations. You will analyse existing processes, identify quick wins and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Your responsibilities

• Reporting: Developing reports, dashboards, views and worklists, potentially in combination with Power BI.

• Automation: Implementing bulk uploads, streamlining transaction processing and reducing manual tasks.

• ERP optimisation: Analysing and improving existing processes within the ERP environment, with a focus on order-to-cash and procure-to-pay.

• Integrations: Optimising data flows and connections with external systems, such as EDI and Excel-based processes.

• Stakeholder management: Coordinating with Finance, Operations and the international IT team, while critically assessing and challenging potential solutions.

• Knowledge transfer: Documenting the implemented solutions to ensure the internal team can maintain them independently after the project.

We are looking for a technically strong, analytical and hands-on consultant who can quickly identify opportunities and deliver pragmatic solutions.

You have:

• Relevant experience with ERP implementations

• Experience with reporting, dashboards, views and worklists

• Good knowledge of Power BI and experience with EDI integrations

• Knowledge of bulk uploads, mass transactions and ERP process optimisation

• An understanding of order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes

• Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is a strong asset, but not an absolute requirement

• A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work within existing system limitations

• Strong communication skills and a good command of English

• Knowledge of Dutch is not required, but is considered a strong asset

• Experience with Azure DevOps is a plus
